observed_mechanism: On parent-03 Deity 49220027834 at turns 31 and 33, the board prices the same Spearman guard 93 at camp (39,24) twice: an ordinary Destroy row needs 42 strength and the ClearCamp row also needs 42 plus its existing two bodies and one melee unit. At turn 33, Camp force 14 has only unit 180 while Destroy force 15 has units 2 and 110 at a distant rally. The camp force advances alone and loses local strength. This is duplicate objective budgeting for the exact same singleton guard, not evidence of extra raiders at that camp. Settler 145 disappears after founding a shelter city at turn 27; it was not established to have been captured.

Let that existing camp objective own the guard and its requested party, as the board already avoids separate Destroy bills for a city under Siege. Preserve grouped hostile forces, ordinary raiders, non-barbarian enemies, late or inactive camp handling, neighbour-delegated camps, arena handling, urgent city-defense rows, the existing camp strength/body/melee requirements and all other victory lanes. Do not change margins, budgets, launch thresholds, unit prices, force membership safety or production priorities.
